symbols.name: Game
symbols.description: Client-side game utilities available to sandboxed client resources.

functions.name: notify
functions.description: Shows a line in the local chat UI.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Message shown in the local chat UI.

functions.name: lockControls
functions.description: Shows the cursor and locks game controls so a focused web view can be clicked. Refcounted per resource: pair each lockControls(true) with exactly one lockControls(false). Stopping a resource releases its holds.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: true shows the cursor and locks controls; false restores gameplay input.

functions.name: areControlsLocked
functions.description: True while anything holds a control lock. Locks are dropped on disconnect, so a lock still held at resource start belongs to another owner — never drain one you did not take.

functions.name: setPauseMenuEnabled
functions.description: Keeps the game's own Field Guide (the pause menu) from opening: ESC, the gamepad menu button and every page hotkey (map, inventory, character, talents, settings...) do nothing while it is held, so a resource can put its own menus behind those keys. The tool wheel, action screen and owl mail are untouched, and a Field Guide already open stays until the player closes it. One hold per resource, idempotent; the menu stays shut while any resource holds. The hold is dropped when the resource stops or reloads and on disconnect, so nothing has to be paired.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: false keeps the game's Field Guide from opening; true gives this resource's hold back.

functions.name: isPauseMenuEnabled
functions.description: False while any resource holds the game's Field Guide shut.

functions.name: pauseMenuState
functions.description: Diagnostic snapshot: enabled mirrors isPauseMenuEnabled(), holders names the resources keeping the Field Guide shut, and locked is whether the game's UI manager currently carries the temp pause lock the hold is applied through (the game raises it itself during cut cameras).

type.name: { enabled: boolean; locked: boolean; holders: string[] }

functions.name: setActionScreenEnabled
functions.description: Keeps the game's action screen (the spell-set editor behind T / d-pad right) from opening, so a resource can own spell loadouts or put its own screen on that key. Casting, the spell diamond and the tool wheel are untouched, and an action screen already open stays until the player closes it. Same contract as setPauseMenuEnabled: one idempotent hold per resource, shut while any resource holds, dropped when the resource stops or reloads and on disconnect.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: false keeps the game's action screen from opening; true gives this resource's hold back.

functions.name: isActionScreenEnabled
functions.description: False while any resource holds the game's action screen shut.

functions.name: actionScreenState
functions.description: Diagnostic snapshot for the action screen hold: holders names the resources keeping it shut, and locked is whether the player's NoEditActionBar game-logic flag, which the hold is applied through, is currently set.

type.name: { enabled: boolean; locked: boolean; holders: string[] }

functions.name: setToolWheelEnabled
functions.description: Keeps the game's tool wheel (Tab / gamepad LB, the consumable and tool selector) from opening, so a resource that owns items or brooms can put its own wheel on that key. Also collapses the stock quick-item HUD slot while held, since it would otherwise sit there drawing an unusable diamond, and restores it on release. Quick item use, casting and the spell diamond are untouched, and a wheel already open stays until the player closes it. Same contract as setPauseMenuEnabled: one idempotent hold per resource, shut while any resource holds, dropped when the resource stops or reloads and on disconnect.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: false keeps the game's tool wheel from opening; true gives this resource's hold back.

functions.name: isToolWheelEnabled
functions.description: False while any resource holds the game's tool wheel shut.

functions.name: toolWheelState
functions.description: Diagnostic snapshot for the tool wheel hold: holders names the resources keeping it shut, and locked is whether the player's TutorialMechanics ItemMenu bit, which the hold is applied through, is currently cleared.

type.name: { enabled: boolean; locked: boolean; holders: string[] }

functions.name: setMenuPageEnabled
functions.description: Keeps one page of the game's Field Guide out of reach while the rest of it, the map included, keeps working: its tab is greyed out and skipped when paging, its hotkey does nothing, and its entry on the Field Guide's first page does nothing. The page stays out through save loads and story unlocks. A page already open stays until the player leaves it. Same contract as setPauseMenuEnabled, per page: one idempotent hold per resource, shut while any resource holds, dropped when the resource stops or reloads and on disconnect. Throws on an unknown page name.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A Field Guide page.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: false keeps the page out of the Field Guide; true gives this resource's hold back.

functions.name: isMenuPageEnabled
functions.description: False while any resource holds that Field Guide page shut.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A Field Guide page.

functions.name: menuPageState
functions.description: Diagnostic snapshot for one page's hold: holders names the resources keeping it shut, and locked is whether the game's own hidden-tab set currently holds the page. The game also hides a tab whose story unlock has not happened yet, so locked can be true with nobody holding it.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A Field Guide page.

type.name: { enabled: boolean; locked: boolean; holders: string[] }

functions.name: _menuPagesState
functions.description: DEV/QA. The Field Guide and its page gates: open (on the screen stack), tabIndex (its CurrentTabIndex, 0 on the index page), hidden (the game's hidden-tab set), vetoed (hotkeys and index entries dropped since boot), reasserted (game rebuilds kept a held page hidden), vetoReady (the veto can fire). Reads only.

type.name: { uiManager: boolean; open: boolean; uiShown: boolean; inMenuTransition: boolean; fieldGuideTransition: boolean; pauseLock: boolean; tabIndex: number | null; activeMenu: string; hidden: string[]; vetoed: number; reasserted: number; vetoReady: boolean }

functions.name: _menuTabToggle
functions.description: DEV/QA. Calls the game's own ToggleMenuTab, the call every save load and story unlock rebuilds the hidden-tab set with, and returns whether the tab is hidden afterwards. Null without the UI manager.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A Field Guide page.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Asks the game to show (true) or hide (false) the tab.

functions.name: _menuPageHotkey
functions.description: DEV/QA. Fires the page's hotkey handler on the player's BTS_Biped_TopLevel through ProcessEvent, as the key would. reason names a refusal: bad-page, no-pawn, no-state-tree or call-failed.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A Field Guide page.

functions.name: _menuPageIndexSelect
functions.description: DEV/QA. Fires the open Field Guide's handler for the page's entry on its first page through ProcessEvent, as a click would. reason names a refusal: bad-page, not-open or call-failed.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A Field Guide page.

functions.name: _fieldGuideOpen
functions.description: DEV/QA. Opens the Field Guide on its first page, as ESC does. requested only means the calls went out; poll _menuPagesState(). reason names a refusal: no-ui-manager, already-open, menu-transition or pause-lock.

functions.name: _fieldGuideClose
functions.description: DEV/QA. Closes an open Field Guide through its own back path. reason names a refusal: no-ui-manager, not-open or call-failed.

functions.name: _openMap
functions.description: DEV/QA. Opens the world map the way the M key does. requested only means the calls went out, since the game refuses silently past its own checks, so poll _mapState(). reason names a refusal: no-ui-manager, already-open, held (a resource holds the map page), menu-transition, dungeon or call-failed.

functions.name: _closeMap
functions.description: DEV/QA. Closes an open map through the Field Guide's own back path. reason names a refusal: no-ui-manager, not-open, no-field-guide or call-failed.

functions.name: _objectArrayWalks
functions.description: DEV/QA. Full GUObjectArray walks the client has started since boot. Diff two reads around an action to prove it never scans the whole object array. Reads only.

functions.name: _minigame
functions.description: QA: the spell-lesson minigame with that game name while it waits for start or runs. Null otherwise.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The lesson's game name, e.g. Revelio.

type.name: { name: string; checkpoint: number; checkpoints: number; expectedInput: number | null; active: boolean; finished: boolean; inputWindowOpen: boolean; waitingForStart: boolean; inputsComplete: boolean } | null

functions.name: _minigamePress
functions.description: QA: presses what the shown lesson waits for now: start, or the open checkpoint's input. pressed is false when it waits for neither.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The lesson's game name.

functions.name: _minigameSucceed
functions.description: QA: finishes the shown lesson as passing its last checkpoint does: success animation, SpellComplete, teardown. False when none is shown.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The lesson's game name.

functions.name: _umgInput
functions.description: QA: dispatches a UMG input action through the world's input manager when a screen listens for it.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: EUMGInputAction value.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: 0 pressed (default), 1 released.

functions.name: _worldLifecycle
functions.description: DEV/QA. Every gate a travel holds the client on, read together: transitionInFlight (reflection walks refuse and fastTravel waits while it is set), the load-screen hold count, the streaming curtain, the game's fast-travel flag, streamingSystem (destination teleports wait until the lifecycle knows the streaming manager), the local readiness phases, and presentationReady (web views composite). sceneRigTransitions and phaseFaults count phase-1 scene rigs and faulted phase reads since boot. foreignSpawnsBlocked holds other players, NPCs and props back from a respawn order until the player is up. A null flag means its manager is not up. Reads only.

type.name: { transitionInFlight: boolean; loadScreenHold: number; curtainDown: boolean | null; fastTravelInProgress: boolean | null; streamingSystem: boolean; worldPrepared: boolean; loadingFinished: boolean; gameplayReady: boolean; presentationReady: boolean; sceneRigTransitions: number; phaseFaults: number; foreignSpawnsBlocked: boolean }

functions.name: _stateInfoParity
functions.description: DEV/QA. One CharacterStateInfo read through the typed SDK and through the reflected getters it replaced: health, maxHealth, isDead, isHealthZero, isNearDeathKneeling, invulnerableToDamage, regenerationRate, healthThresholds. A field is null when that side could not read it. Reads only.

parameters.name: npcId
parameters.description: 0 or omitted = the local player; otherwise this client's pawn for that NPC.

type.name: { native: Record<string, number | boolean | null>; reflected: Record<string, number | boolean | null> } | null

functions.name: _preloadDialogueTables
functions.description: DEV/QA. Runs the lip-sync's once-per-process player dialogue-table preload through the native static, then the reflected UFunction it replaced, and reports whether each returned a live handle. reflected is null when the UFunction could not be called.

functions.name: _setInvulnerableToDamage
functions.description: DEV/QA. Writes the invulnerable-to-damage flag through the typed SDK setter, so a suite can read it back through the reflected getter. False when there is no state info.

parameters.name: npcId
parameters.description: 0 = the local player.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: The flag to write.

functions.name: _transformParity
functions.description: DEV/QA. One pawn's location and rotation read through the typed SDK (the root component's world transform) and through the reflected K2_GetActorLocation / K2_GetActorRotation it replaced, in the same frame. rejectsComponent: the typed read refused the pawn's root component, which is not an actor. Reads only.

parameters.name: npcId
parameters.description: 0 or omitted = the local player; otherwise this client's pawn for that NPC.

type.name: { classResolved: boolean; native: { x: number; y: number; z: number; pitch: number; yaw: number; roll: number } | null; reflected: { x: number; y: number; z: number; pitch: number; yaw: number; roll: number } | null; rejectsComponent: boolean } | null

functions.name: _componentParity
functions.description: DEV/QA. For a fixed set of component classes (one a pawn lacks), looks the pawn's component up through the native FindComponentByClass and through the reflected GetComponentByClass it replaced. found: the native lookup returned one; same: both returned the same object. rejectsComponent: the native lookup refused the pawn's root component, which is not an actor. Reads only.

parameters.name: npcId
parameters.description: 0 or omitted = the local player; otherwise this client's pawn for that NPC.

type.name: { classes: { name: string; resolved: boolean; found?: boolean; same?: boolean }[]; rejectsComponent: boolean } | null

functions.name: _sdkSwapParity
functions.description: DEV/QA. Every typed SDK member the reflection swaps moved onto, read beside the reflected call it replaced, in one frame: the local player, its wand, mesh, anim instance, controller and state info, every live spell tool (up to 32), five spell locks, the mount gates, live AIControllers (up to 16), every new class guard against its reflected class, the ridden creature mount when riding one, and the GameLogic variables, expressions and bitfield the menu gate reads, against the reflected `_OnActor` statics. The GameLogic write rows round-trip a bool, the idle stack and the item-menu bit in the same frame and restore each. found: the typed side answered (for a write row, the write landed); same: both sides agree; count: objects compared. Null without a local pawn.

type.name: { name: string; found: boolean; same: boolean; count: number }[] | null

functions.name: _npcSdkParity
functions.description: DEV/QA. The typed NPC_Component / EnemyAIComponent / NPC_Character members the NPC swaps moved onto, beside the reflected calls they replaced, on one NPC in one frame: the component lookups, target, target type, flying, target-sighted and perception flags, the perception params, the sense TargetChanged is handed (npcTargetSense: the AISense_EnemyAITarget CDO the game caches at NPC_Component+0x11C0) and the team response to the local player. The write rows round-trip the target-sighted, perception and exclude-player stores and restore each. found: the typed side answered (for a write row, the write landed); same: both sides agree. Null without that NPC's pawn.

parameters.name: npcId
parameters.description: The NPC whose local pawn is read.

type.name: { name: string; found: boolean; same: boolean; count: number }[] | null

functions.name: _mountFlyingParity
functions.description: DEV/QA. The MountFlying flag the last local tick replicated (the typed mount-component read) beside the reflected IsFlying on the possessed pawn's Creature_MountComponent, else its NPC_Component. reflected is null when neither answers. Null without a possessed pawn. Reads only.

type.name: { published: boolean; reflected: boolean | null; possessedClass: string } | null

functions.name: _npcInteraction
functions.description: DEV/QA. The NPC's team response to the local player ("Attack", "Flee", "AllyWith", ...), read through the typed CharacterStateInfo native and the reflected GetInteractionBetween. "None" without a state info; null without that NPC's pawn or a local pawn. Reads only.

parameters.name: npcId
parameters.description: The NPC whose local pawn is the interactor.

type.name: { typed: string; reflected: string | null } | null

functions.name: _moveProbe
functions.description: DEV/QA. In one frame: moves the pawn dx along X through the native SetActorLocation, reads the result typed (native) and through the reflected K2_GetActorLocation (reflected), then teleports it back through the native TeleportTo and reads home. Null when the pawn is missing.

parameters.name: npcId
parameters.description: 0 = the local player; otherwise this client's pawn for that NPC.

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: Centimetres to move along X. Default 50.

type.name: { before: Vec3; target: Vec3; moved: boolean; native: Vec3 | null; reflected: Vec3 | null; teleported: boolean; home: Vec3 | null } | null

functions.name: _mapState
functions.description: DEV/QA. The map and Field Guide state, plus which pawn the local controller possesses: an open map swaps the player's body for the map subsystem's MapPawn. standInHeld is whether the local publishers are holding because of that. mapActive is null without a map subsystem.

type.name: { uiManager: boolean; mapActive: boolean | null; uiShown: boolean; inMenuTransition: boolean; fieldGuideTransition: boolean; activeMenu: string; possessedClass: string; possessedIsBody: boolean; possessedIsMapPawn: boolean; standInHeld: boolean }

symbols.name: Audio
symbols.description: Local Wwise playback. Sounds are named game events (see Audio.playSoundAt on the server for the replicated form); a bank that isn't resident makes the post silently return 0.

functions.name: playSoundAt
functions.description: Posts a spatialized one-shot at a world position.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Wwise event name, e.g. "cabbage_explosion" (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: World-space X coordinate.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: World-space Y coordinate.

parameters.name: z
parameters.description: World-space Z coordinate.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: duration = seconds until it ends itself; stopEvent = terminator override (auto-resolved from the game data when omitted); autoStop = false disables that lookup.

type.name: { duration?: number, stopEvent?: string, autoStop?: boolean }

returns.description: AkPlayingID for stopSound, or 0 when the post was refused.

functions.name: playSound
functions.description: Posts an event on the local pawn, i.e. at the listener (no distance falloff).

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Wwise event name.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: duration = seconds until it ends itself; stopEvent = terminator override (auto-resolved from the game data when omitted); autoStop = false disables that lookup.

type.name: { duration?: number, stopEvent?: string, autoStop?: boolean }

returns.description: AkPlayingID, or 0 when the post was refused.

functions.name: stopSound
functions.description: Stops one playing sound, posting its registered stopEvent first when it has one.

parameters.name: playingId
parameters.description: An id returned by playSound/playSoundAt.

functions.name: stopEventFor
functions.description: The terminator that would be posted for this event, derived from the game's own soundbanks.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Wwise event name.

returns.description: The stop event's name, or "" when the event is a one-shot that needs none.

functions.name: stopOnSelf
functions.description: Stops every sound posted on the local pawn — where playSound puts them. The way out of a held/looping event whose id you no longer have.

functions.name: stopAll
functions.description: Stops every sound in the engine, including the game's own music and ambience (those mostly re-post on their own). A last resort.

functions.name: bankFor
functions.description: The soundbank this event needs loaded, from the cooked assets' own RequiredBank.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Wwise event name.

returns.description: The bank name, or "" for an unknown event.

functions.name: isBankLoaded
functions.description: Whether THIS client loaded that bank. The game streams its own banks with the area and reports nothing, so false does not mean an event cannot play.

parameters.name: bank
parameters.description: Soundbank name.

functions.name: loadBank
functions.description: Loads a soundbank so its events can be posted. Custom banks are read from Phoenix/Content/WwiseAudio/Windows/.

parameters.name: bank
parameters.description: Soundbank name without the .bnk extension.

returns.description: True when the call reached the engine; the engine itself reports no result.

functions.name: unloadBank
functions.description: Unloads a soundbank.

parameters.name: bank
parameters.description: Soundbank name.

functions.name: setMusic
functions.description: Pushes a track onto the game's music priority stack. Only events that actually contain a Play action work — most "music" event names only flip Wwise states.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Music event name (must be unique while pushed).

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Stack priority, clamped to -5..5 (default 5 = above the game's score).

functions.name: clearMusic
functions.description: Pops a track off the music stack, starting whatever was under it. It cannot restore state-driven score, and the name stays blocked for the session.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: The event name passed to setMusic.

functions.name: setRTPC
functions.description: Sets a global Wwise real-time parameter.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Wwise RTPC name.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New value.

functions.name: setState
functions.description: Sets a global Wwise state.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Wwise state group.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State within the group.

symbols.name: Blips
symbols.description: Map, minimap and compass markers.

functions.name: setMarker
functions.description: Creates or replaces the world marker under this key.

functions.name: remove
functions.description: Removes the marker or circle under this key.

functions.name: clear
functions.description: Removes every script blip.

functions.name: setPlayerColor
functions.description: Per-player blip colour (0-1 linear); omit rgb to revert to the house colour.

functions.name: setAllPlayerColors
functions.description: Colour every tracked blip; no args reverts to house colours.

functions.name: trackedPlayers
functions.description: Network ids of tracked remote players.

functions.name: trackPlayer
functions.description: Whether this player gets a blip; may be set before they spawn.

functions.name: setTrackedPlayers
functions.description: The whole set of players with blips; anyone else loses theirs.

functions.name: trackAllPlayers
functions.description: Blip every remote player (the default), or only tracked ones.

functions.name: hideBaseIcon
functions.description: HIDEFROMMAP the underlying beacon while tinting.

functions.name: setBlipScale
functions.description: Player blip size; 1.0 is about twice the game's own icons.

functions.name: setHouseTint
functions.description: Toggles house-coloured player blips (experimental).

functions.name: houseTint
functions.description: Reads the house-tint toggle.

functions.name: debugDump
functions.description: Reports resolved beacon/minimap state.

functions.name: styles
functions.description: Which beacon types are safe to register.

functions.name: dumpStyles
functions.description: Full UI_DT_CompassStyles dump by reflection.

functions.name: styleDiff
functions.description: Hexdumps two types' compass-style structs for diffing.

functions.name: setHud
functions.description: ShowOnHUD for new blips (false = no 3D world marker).

functions.name: inArea
functions.description: Is this point inside the circle under this key?

functions.name: setCircle
functions.description: Creates or replaces the search circle under this key. METRES.

functions.name: pulseCircle
functions.description: PulseCircleIcon (true) or FadeInCircleIcon (false).

functions.name: probe
functions.description: Diffs our beacon against a game beacon of the same type.

functions.name: setIcon
functions.description: BeaconIcon for new blips; empty lifts it off a live beacon.

functions.name: setType
functions.description: EBeaconType for new markers (24 = FINDLOCATION).

functions.name: setScale
functions.description: BeaconScale on live mod beacons (mission-area circle radius).

functions.name: _sdkParity
functions.description: DEV/QA. Every typed SDK member the blip code moved onto, read beside the reflected call it replaced, in one frame: the beacon manager, up to 24 registered beacons (handle lookup and every laid-out field), the registry, UI_DT_CompassStyles rows and icon columns, the minimap manager, active minimap and its getters, the icon render widgets, IconExistsInTable and the control rotation. dynamicBeacon registers an enemy beacon on the local pawn and beaconUnregister removes it again in the same frame. found: the typed side answered; same: both sides agree; detail names what differed.

parameters.name: markerKey
parameters.description: A live marker whose registration is checked too.

type.name: { name: string; found: boolean; same: boolean; count: number; detail?: string }[]

functions.name: setState
functions.description: Sets EBeaconState on every mod beacon (4 = DISCOVERED).

functions.name: setRoute
functions.description: Draws the game's gold mission route to a blip on the map and minimap, replacing this client's last route. It survives the target being re-shown or respawning; a route to a circle ends at its ring. The player's own map waypoint still wins the minimap while placed and hands it back when removed. Returns whether the game took it.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: A live marker or circle key, or a tracked player's network id.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The route's long name.

functions.name: clearRoute
functions.description: Ends the route, re-tracking the player's own waypoint if they placed one. False when there was none. Removing the routed blip ends it too.

functions.name: route
functions.description: The routed blip key, or a player's network id, or null.

functions.name: _routeState
functions.description: DEV/QA. Our route beside the game's own slots: the tracked, waymarker and mission beacon handles, whether it tracks the waymarker, HasDestinationLocation, GetCanPlayerTrackDestination, the minimap route's point count, and the tracked/mission/waypoint colours the map would draw.

type.name: { key: string | null; player: number | null; label: string; target: number; applied: number; testWaymarker: number; pathNavigation: boolean; tracked: number; waymarker: number; mission: number; trackingWaymarker: boolean; hasDestination: boolean; canTrack: boolean; minimapPathPoints: number; trackedColor: { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number } | null; missionColor: { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number } | null; waypointColor: { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number } | null }

functions.name: _routeWaymarker
functions.description: DEV/QA. Stands in for the player's own map waypoint the way the map places one: a WayMarker beacon in the waymarker slot, tracked. Returns its handle, 0 if refused.

functions.name: _routeWaymarkerRemove
functions.description: DEV/QA. Removes the stand-in waypoint through the game's own BeaconRemoved restore, then puts back a real waypoint it displaced.

functions.name: begin
functions.description: Claims the editing session and snapshots the appearance, so cancel() can restore it. Returns false if the F5 overlay or another resource already holds it — check before showing your UI.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Reserved; a session always starts from the current look today.

functions.name: commit
functions.description: Keeps the edits: settles the look into its persistable form and releases the snapshot. False if you don't hold the session. Queued patches are guaranteed to be applied BEFORE the settle -- but this RETURNS IMMEDIATELY, it does not wait for the game to finish. Do not read the look off the back of it; wait for the server's playerAppearanceChanged instead.

functions.name: cancel
functions.description: Discards the edits and restores the snapshot taken by begin(). False if you don't hold the session.

functions.name: getSchema
functions.description: Every category and the stable option ids it accepts. null until built (begin() primes it). GENDER-SCOPED: a full-body preset switches gender and re-resolves every category, so re-read after one.

functions.name: getState
functions.description: The current selections, face gear, voice and name. Refreshed after each applyPatch, so read it on `creatorChanged` rather than immediately after patching.

functions.name: applyPatch
functions.description: Queues one apply per entry and returns how many were queued (not how many succeeded — an unknown id is dropped on the game thread and logged). An EMPTY string clears the category, which only face gear supports. `preset` is applied FIRST because it can switch gender. Throws without an active session.

parameters.description: category -> option id, e.g. { hairStyle: "DA_HairMale012" }.

functions.description: Sets the voice. Not a preset category, so it cannot ride applyPatch. Returns whether anything was queued; read the result back on creatorChanged. Requires an active session.

functions.name: setReactPolicy
functions.description: WRITES. The victim-side stagger economy: after `maxChain` staggers inside `window` seconds (or one unbroken stagger longer than `window`), impacts from other players stop requesting a hit reaction on the local pawn until `suppressFor` seconds after the current stagger ends, so a spammed basic attack can no longer chain full-body reactions into an unanswerable lock. Damage, PvE hits and death are never affected. Defaults: 2 staggers per 1.5s, then 1s of stagger immunity.

parameters.name: policy
parameters.description: Omitted fields keep their current value; a bare boolean toggles `enabled`.

type.name: { enabled?: boolean, maxChain?: number, window?: number, suppressFor?: number } | boolean

functions.name: reactStatus
functions.description: Reads the react policy's live state: the resolved reaction component, whether a reaction is running right now, the current chain count and any active suppression window. Reads only.

functions.name: reactState
functions.description: reactStatus as data. An empty `component` means the pawn carries no ability component and the stagger cap is inert; `reactionRunning` is null when the readback itself failed; `cancels` counts remote impacts whose reaction request was dropped, `impacts` every remote impact seen on the pawn (dropped or not). Reads only.

type.name: { enabled: boolean, maxChain: number, window: number, suppressFor: number, component: string, activeAbility: string, lastStagger: string, reactionRunning: boolean | null, chain: number, suppressed: boolean, suppressedFor: number, suppressions: number, cancels: number, impacts: number, probeQueued: number }

functions.name: restoreReactions
functions.description: WRITES. Ends any active stagger-immunity window now and turns the pawn's reactions back on, leaving the policy itself alone. Call it wherever a duel or gamemode ends — reactions must never be left off.

functions.name: _watchReactions
functions.description: Samples the local pawn's reaction component every tick and counts reactions that actually began — the readback that turns "the stagger cap worked" into a measurement. Off by default: a reflected call per frame is not free.

parameters.name: on
parameters.description: true (default) resets the counters and starts sampling; false stops.

type.name: { active: boolean, starts: number, samples: number, running: number, componentLost: boolean }

functions.name: _reactObservation
functions.description: Reads the reaction counters without arming or resetting them. `componentLost` means a sample could not reach the component, so the counts are incomplete. Reads only.

type.name: { active: boolean, starts: number, samples: number, running: number, componentLost: boolean }

functions.name: _noteStagger

parameters.name: times
parameters.description: How many observed staggers to feed; default 1.

functions.name: _staggerRun
functions.description: DEV/QA. Runs the whole stagger reproduction end to end: spawns the dev students if fewer are up, makes them hostile for the burst, arms the diagnostic, fires the rounds, restores their teams and closes the window 2s after the last one. reactState().probeQueued reaches 0 at the last round; read the summary with _reactDiag(0).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Rounds to fire; default 6.

parameters.name: intervalMs
parameters.description: Spacing in milliseconds; default 400.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: pattern: what each round casts (default combo = 3x Stupefy then StupefyHeavy, the records a remote player's replay sends); students: how many dev students take turns casting (1-4, default 1; a round = one cast from each, one per interval — same-tick casts of one record collapse in the pooled spell tool); upgraded: replay through each spell's own tool with the local player's upgrades, the path an upgraded remote player's casts take — its munitions are damage-stripped.

functions.name: _despawnStudents
functions.description: DEV/QA. Despawns every dev student proxy on the next tick — the cleanup for _staggerRun.

functions.name: _reactDiag
functions.description: DEV. Samples every ability channel, the combat-AnimBP FullBodyState and IsPlayingAbility for a window, then reports the distinct values with counts — the readout that says where the player's stagger actually lives.

parameters.name: ms
parameters.description: Sampling window in milliseconds (default 4000); 0 stops sampling and returns what was seen.

functions.name: _staggerProbe
functions.description: DEV. Fires the human basic combo (3x Stupefy then StupefyHeavy) from the dev student proxy at the local pawn so the FullBody stagger chain reproduces on ONE client — the same records and instigator class a remote player's replay sends. symbols.description: Local player's proximity voice chat settings: on/off, playback volume, hearing range and the push-to-talk binding.

functions.name: setEnabled
functions.description: Turns voice chat on or off. Off closes the microphone and playback devices and tells the server to stop relaying voice to this client.

parameters.description: Whether voice chat runs at all for this player.

functions.name: isEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether voice chat is enabled for this player.

returns.description: True unless the player turned voice chat off.

functions.name: setVolume
functions.description: Sets the playback volume of incoming voice. A game that plays voice through its own audio engine applies the same gain there.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Playback gain, where 1 is unattenuated. Clamped to 0..4.

functions.name: getVolume
functions.description: Reads the voice playback volume.

functions.name: setHearingRange
functions.description: Narrows how far this player hears others. Can only reduce the server's range, since a talker beyond it is never relayed.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Audibility radius in world units; 0 removes the local limit.

functions.name: getHearingRange
functions.description: Reads the local hearing-range limit.

returns.description: Radius in world units, or 0 when the server's range applies unreduced.

functions.name: getRange
functions.description: Reads the server's proximity range for talkers with no override of their own.

functions.name: setTier
functions.description: Switches how far this player's voice carries. A request: the server paces it, decides the radius, and may move the player itself.

parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: Voice tier: 0 whisper, 1 normal, 2 shout.

functions.name: getTier
functions.description: Reads the voice tier this player is on.

functions.name: setPushToTalkKey
functions.description: Rebinds push-to-talk. Unknown key names throw.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Case-insensitive key name, using the same names as Key.bind.

functions.name: getPushToTalkKey
functions.description: Reads the push-to-talk binding.

functions.name: setPushToTalkReleaseDelay
functions.description: Sets how long transmission continues after push-to-talk is released, so letting go slightly early does not clip the end of a word. Muting, turning voice off and losing input focus still stop it at once.

parameters.name: milliseconds
parameters.description: How long to keep transmitting after the key goes up. Clamped to 0..2000.

functions.name: getPushToTalkReleaseDelay
functions.description: Reads the push-to-talk release delay.

returns.description: Delay in milliseconds; 0 when transmission stops the moment the key is released.

functions.name: isTalking
functions.description: Checks whether the local player is speaking right now. The same state raises the voiceStart and voiceStop events.

returns.description: True while push-to-talk is open -- held, or still inside the release delay -- and the microphone is producing audio.

functions.name: hasMicrophone
functions.description: Checks whether a capture device opened for this session.

returns.description: False when the player has no working microphone, i.e. they are listen-only.

functions.name: setTransmitMode
functions.description: Chooses what opens the microphone. Switching closes whatever the previous mode had open. Unknown modes throw.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: pushToTalk sends while the key is held; voiceActivity sends whenever the microphone is louder than the activation threshold.

functions.name: getTransmitMode
functions.description: Reads what opens the microphone.

functions.name: setActivationThreshold
functions.description: Sets the voice-activation sensitivity: lower sends quieter speech, higher ignores more background noise. Clamped to 0..1.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Microphone level, 0 to 1 on the scale getInputLevel reports, above which voice activation sends.

functions.name: getActivationThreshold
functions.description: Reads the voice-activation threshold.

functions.name: getInputLevel
functions.description: Reads how loud the microphone is right now, whether or not anything is being sent -- the value to draw a level meter from and to tune the activation threshold against.

returns.description: Smoothed level from 0 to 1; 0 while no microphone is open.

functions.name: setNoiseSuppression
functions.description: Turns noise suppression on or off. It runs before the level is measured, so it also keeps steady noise from tripping voice activation.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether to filter background noise out of the microphone.

functions.name: isNoiseSuppressionEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether noise suppression is on.

returns.description: True while background noise is being filtered.

functions.name: getInputDevice

symbols.description: The local player's view of the nametags above players: whether they draw at all, whether they carry a health bar, and whether their own is shown.

functions.description: Shows or hides all nametags for this player only. A player hidden with Player.setNametagVisible stays hidden either way.

parameters.description: True to draw nametags, false to hide every one of them.

functions.name: isVisible
functions.description: Checks whether this player draws nametags.

returns.description: True unless they were hidden locally.

functions.description: Shows or hides the health bar on all nametags for this player only, leaving the names alone.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: True to draw the health bar under each name, false to hide it.

functions.name: isHealthVisible
functions.description: Checks whether this player draws health bars on nametags.

returns.description: True unless they were hidden locally.

functions.name: setSelfVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides this player's own nametag, drawn as others see it, with any label set on their own id.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: True to draw this player's own nametag, false (default) to leave it off.

functions.name: isSelfVisible
functions.description: Checks whether this player draws their own nametag.

returns.description: False unless it was turned on locally.

functions.name: setLabel
functions.description: Hangs a transient line on that entity's nametag, above its name -- speech, an emote, a status. It follows the body, fades with distance and hides behind cover exactly as the name does. Local to this player: the line is not replicated, and a nametag hidden with Nametags.setVisible draws neither. Player.setNametagText is the server-side counterpart for a lasting name.

parameters.name: entityId

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Label text; '\n' splits lines. Empty clears the label.

parameters.name: durationMs
parameters.description: How long to hold it (default 6000). <= 0 holds until cleared.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Packed 0xAARRGGBB; 0 (default) uses the nametag's own colour.

functions.name: clearLabel
functions.description: Removes an entity's label before its duration elapses.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Network id of the entity whose label to remove.

functions.name: clearLabels
functions.description: Removes every label this player is drawing.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Reads one key from this entity's state.

parameters.description: Key to read.

functions.description: Checks whether this entity's state holds a key.

parameters.name: handle
